Author: virgoarya
Message:
fix(release): perbaikan keamanan, keandalan trading, dan kebersihan kode (30+ bug, 3 batch)

Batch 1 - Security:
- WS auth real: authenticateWebSocket + Origin check (hapus isAuthenticated bypass)
- ENCRYPTION_KEY wajib di production (fallback hardcoded dihapus)
- Password broker MT5 terenkripsi AES + decrypt legacy plaintext
- NODE_ENV default production; dev-test session token raw (kompatibel better-auth)
- OTA version gate compareVersions + rollback rename-safe (anti boot loop)
- triggerStart ownership check; /clear-cache requireAuth

Batch 2 - Trading reliability:
- pythonQueue: serialisasi spawn trade_api.py (MT5 1 koneksi Python)
- trade_api.py: deviation 30, round digits, None-guard, pick_filling FOK>IOC>RETURN
- Order duplication guard saat hasil python uncertain
- busySymbols unlock semua simbol per-tick; sync re-entrancy guard
- Backtest config isolasi via AsyncLocalStorage (tidak mutasi config live)
- Frontend: settings wipe guard, WS reconnect fix, useWebSocket tanpa teardown, BacktestStreamView error state, polling tanpa flicker

Batch 3 - Kebersihan:
- execSync import, single-instance lock, restart cap 5, check-now nyata
- Index compound Trade/AITradeLog; backtest upsert + dateRange
- trust proxy false (anti rate-limit bypass); mcpService.shutdown
- error-handler 5xx generic; macro-data releaseDate guard
- server.py: asyncio.to_thread, comment [:31], SL/TP 0 clear, filling priority
- fetch_rates.py error jelas; build.bat errorlevel check
